decisions.reason: The portfolio-tile link is a separate request in the same message and is already fully represented by its own INTRODUCE Event; the photo-selection change does not alter it.
Replacing indicated stock assets does not change the rule that each service must have a corresponding relevant image, and the source does not identify the Services page as an affected placement.
The requested asset replacements and house photograph remain consistent with the existing sitewide image-focused design requirement and do not modify its visual-emphasis rule.

Changing the homepage photograph's subject does not alter the candidate's design direction, image emphasis, blue overlay color, opacity, or highlight effect; the asset choice is owned by the source Requirement.
The photo-asset decision does not change the itemized pricing layout, service coverage, pricing transparency, or item classification.
The source does not change the gallery's browsing mode, tab organization, or secondary content; the portfolio-tile link is separately represented.
The source photo changes do not modify the existing Gallery, Pricing, and Services button destinations, while the portfolio-tile link is a separate Requirement.
The word photos refers to visual assets in the source, not the calculator's selectable photography service or any quote-calculation rule.
Changing homepage imagery and stock-photo assets does not change the required animation level.
The photo-selection decision does not alter the pricing navigation entry or its destination.
The requested image replacements do not affect package count, package display, square-footage categories, pricing model, or rates.
The photo-asset changes do not modify whether gallery hover animations are enabled on desktop or mobile.
